card.name: Linking words between drugs and interacting substances
card.fires_on: The word "or" (sometimes "and" or "from") right after a noun like drugs, food or foods in interaction warnings. Also the letter C inside CYP2C enzyme names.

modes.label: Or/and after drugs or food
modes.description: A joining word after drugs, food or foods that introduces a second kind of interacting substance.
modes.example: Exercise caution when using sirolimus with drugs<< or>> agents that are modulators of CYP

modes.label: C inside CYP2C names
modes.description: The letter C within CYP2C8 or CYP2C9 enzyme names.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words and code fragments with no clear link, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the small word that links drugs or foods to another interacting substance, such as "drugs or agents".
